name: EOLSSU! : Groove of the Janggu
summary:
# 1. Immersive 3D Janggu Performance

**Experience the Resonance of Traditional Korean Music at Your Fingertips**

The intricate structure of the traditional Korean janggu has been brought to life in a vivid VR environment. Pick up the VR controllers and use them as drumsticks to strike both sides of the janggu.
